verdict.rationale: Tilled documents batch closing for settlement at end of shift, a mock card-present provider for terminal creation/testing, and payouts/reporting/disputes that presumably unify online and in-person transactions under the same merchant balance and dashboard. However, there is no evidence of an actual terminal hardware catalog, tap-to-pay SDK for mobile devices, or documented reconciliation showing in-person and online payments reported identically in production. missing for 10: production tap-to-pay/mobile SDK documentation, physical terminal device support details, explicit confirmation that in-person settlement flows into the same balance/reporting as online with concrete examples, independent/hands-on corroboration beyond docs.
